name: Gedou Yuusha
source:
Lucas is a knight and he is about to hunt down the devil. Just when he gives the devil the final blow, the devil suddenly says, "You're really strong. Why don't you collude with me? I'll give you a half of the world." He answers in no time, "OK!" He starts shagging the princesses immediately and his deeds gradually get bolder and bolder....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090106093622/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005748]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
卢卡斯是一名骑士，正准备讨伐恶魔。就在他即将给予恶魔最后一击时，对方突然说道：“你真的很强。要不要与我联手？我会把一半世界送给你。”卢卡斯毫不犹豫地回答：“好！”随后，他立刻开始与公主们寻欢作乐，行事也渐渐变得愈发大胆…

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090106093622/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005748]ErogeShop[/url]]
